description: The lab APK (EAS build android-apk-lab) cold-started three times on a slim redroid 14 (1.5 CPU, no GPU, 432x1200@192, the pixel count of the earlier 540x960@240) that the suite boots and removes: cold start from launch to the first `ReactNativeJS: Running "main"` log line (`am start -W` times out on this device), the app's PSS, RSS, Java heap, native heap (Hermes lives here) and code from `dumpsys meminfo`, the device's used RAM, and crashes in the crash buffer. Lab-only: an ARM container on a shared VM, not a phone. The APK is a fixed EAS build (apkUrl), so the numbers move with the device and the slim set, not with JS changes, until the URL is bumped to a newer build; APP_BENCH_APK_URL overrides it.
